title: Gander, an Android file viewer that asks for no permissions
claim: Show HN: Gander, an Android file viewer that asks for no permissions
why_good: Gander is a 15 MB open-source Android file viewer that opens PDF, Office, images, video, audio, Markdown, and code entirely offline, with zero permissions and no internet access. It renders everything on-device using sandboxed WebView and native libraries, and integrates via share sheet and 'Open with'.
value: Privacy-conscious Android users pay $2-5 one-time or a small subscription for a single app that opens any file offline without permissions, saving them from cloud uploads and data tracking.
risk: Google could add offline viewing to Files by default, or users will stick with free pre-installed apps, making Gander a feature not a company.

does: Gander is a 15 MB open-source Android file viewer that opens PDF, Office, images, video, audio, Markdown, and code entirely offline, with zero permissions and no internet access. It renders everything on-device using sandboxed WebView and native libraries, and integrates via share sheet and 'Open with'.
why_use: Users are fed up with built-in viewers that are limited or push documents to cloud services, and with permission-hungry apps that track them. Gander offers a single app that handles all file types privately, with no ads, no tracking, and no internet permission, so there's nothing to trust.
gap: Android file viewers are either permission-heavy or limited in format support, leaving a gap for a zero-permission, offline, all-format viewer that non-technical users can actually use.
counter: Google's own Files app and Android's built-in viewers already handle common formats, and Google Drive or Microsoft Office apps are pre-installed on many devices. A platform could add offline viewing as a feature, and the no-permission trick is a niche selling point that most users don't care about.
differentiator: Package Gander for ordinary people: put it on the Play Store, add a simple onboarding that explains the privacy benefit, and offer a premium tier with automatic updates and cloud-free document editing.
hook: Android users who open a PDF, DOCX, or XLSX from chat or email and get bounced to a cloud viewer or a half-broken built-in app, with no offline, no-permission option.

zh.claim: 一个15MB的开源Android文件查看器，完全离线，零权限，无广告，无跟踪，无网络访问。
zh.hook: Android用户从聊天或邮件打开PDF、DOCX或XLSX时，被弹到云端查看器或半残的内置应用，却没有离线、无权限的选择。
zh.does: Gander是一个15MB的开源Android文件查看器，完全离线打开PDF、Office、图片、视频、音频、Markdown和代码，零权限且无网络访问。它通过沙盒WebView和原生库在设备上渲染所有内容，并支持分享和“打开方式”集成。
zh.why_use: 用户厌倦了内置查看器的局限或推送文档到云端服务，也厌倦了要求权限并跟踪他们的应用。Gander提供一个单一应用，私密处理所有文件类型，无广告、无跟踪、无网络权限，无需信任。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用：它是一个侧载APK，没有Play商店存在，缺乏围绕它的精致产品——没有引导，普通用户没有自动更新，也没有iOS或桌面版。
zh.counter: 谷歌自己的Files应用和Android内置查看器已处理常见格式，且Google Drive或Microsoft Office应用在许多设备上预装。平台可以添加离线查看作为功能，无权限技巧是大多数用户不关心的利基卖点。
zh.differentiator: 为普通人打包Gander：上架Play商店，添加简单引导解释隐私优势，并提供高级版，包含自动更新和无云文档编辑。
zh.value: 注重隐私的Android用户一次性支付2-5美元或小额订阅，获得一个无需权限即可离线打开任何文件的应用，避免云上传和数据跟踪。
zh.risk: 谷歌可能默认在Files中添加离线查看，或者用户坚持使用免费的预装应用，使Gander成为功能而非公司。
zh.why_good: Gander是一个15MB的开源Android文件查看器，完全离线打开PDF、Office、图片、视频、音频、Markdown和代码，零权限且无网络访问。它通过沙盒WebView和原生库在设备上渲染所有内容，并支持分享和“打开方式”集成。

consumer_angle: Ordinary people want to open any file on their phone without granting permissions or needing internet, and Gander addresses that but needs polish and distribution.
pick_reason: Strong concept and HN traction, but no verified demand quotes or behavioral evidence yet, and the gap is clear but the wedge is uncertain due to competition.
